# Dataset Readiness and Export {#sec-dataset}

![Dataset readiness and provenance. Source: `docs/adr/architecture/06-dataset-provenance-flow.mmd`.](../../adr/architecture/rendered/06-dataset-provenance-flow.png){#fig-dataset width=95%}

`DatasetManifestService` (`dr_support/services/dataset.py`) serves `GET /v1/dataset/manifest` (preview) and `POST /v1/dataset/export`. The schema source of truth is `docs/reference/DATASET_MANIFEST.md` (`s4.dataset-manifest.v2`, eligibility policy `s8.2-task-specific-v1`).

## Task-specific readiness

Both tasks need all of the following:

- valid source provenance (a SHA-256 identity);
- queue state `INCLUDED`;
- admission `FUNDUS_ACCEPTED`;
- quality neither `UNGRADABLE` nor `NEEDS_REVIEW`;
- a confirmed image (`reviewed_by` and `reviewed_at`, or a legacy-compatible record).

On top of that, each task has one extra requirement:

| Task | Extra requirement | Reason code when missing |
|:-----|:------------------|:-------------------------|
| **DR-ready** (`dr_grade_training_ready`) | A final grade with source `AI_ACCEPTED` / `AI_CORRECTED` / `MANUAL`, plus reviewer and timestamp | `NO_FINAL_CLINICIAN_GRADE`, `MISSING_PROVENANCE` |
| **Lesion-ready** (`lesion_training_ready`) | A current Confirm Annotation whose hash equals the active-set hash, plus reviewer and timestamp | `NO_ANNOTATION_CONFIRMATION` |

: Readiness rules. {#tbl-readiness tbl-colwidths="[28,46,26]"}

AI-only evidence is never promoted to ground truth. Untouched AI, human, corrected, removed, and CVAT-imported annotations stay distinguishable in `annotations.csv` (`annotation_source`, `original_label`, `original_score`, `original_geometry_json`).

## Export package

`export()` writes `<output>/dataset-export-<UTC timestamp>-<8 hex>/`. The directory is created exclusively, and it is removed again on any failure. It contains:

- `manifest.json`: counts, `coordinate_system: original_image_pixels`, lesion taxonomy, `grouping_policy: patient_key_only; no automatic train-validation-test split`, and the SHA-256 of both CSV files;
- `images.csv`: one row per image, with the fields listed in `IMAGE_FIELDS`;
- `annotations.csv`: one row per annotation, with the fields listed in `ANNOTATION_FIELDS`.

Source images and case records are never modified by an export. `training_group_key` (`patient:<key>`) is exported so that any future experiment can split by patient. The software itself creates no split.
